title: KG-DF: A Black-box Defense Framework against Jailbreak Attacks Based on Knowledge Graphs
measurement_description: The paper does not specifically measure or evaluate faith or religion. Instead, it proposes a Knowledge Graph Defense Framework (KG-DF) to protect Large Language Models against jailbreak attacks. Within the Knowledge Graph constructed for this defense, 'Religious' bias, 'Religious Hate', and 'Philosophy and Religion' are included as categorical domains/subcategories in the Safety Knowledge and General Knowledge modules. The evaluation focuses on Attack Success Rate (ASR) reduction and model generality, not specifically on religious concepts.
findings: There were no specific findings related to religion. The paper overall found that the proposed KG-DF framework effectively minimized the attack success rate (ASR) for jailbreak attacks on both open-source and closed-source models while maintaining or improving overall model generality. Religion was merely included as an underlying taxonomic category in their knowledge graph framework.
